item.title: Policy Analyst
item.description:
This position was posted with no close date and applications may be reviewed or closed on a rolling basis — interested applicants should apply ASAP! The posting will be removed from Batten Connect on 8/14/2026.

Founded in 1977, ZERO TO THREE works to ensure that babies and toddlers benefit from the early connections critical to their well-being and development. The Policy Center at ZERO TO THREE is seeking a Policy Analyst to advance ZERO TO THREE's federal policy agenda and strategy, with primary responsibility over child care, tax policies for families, and other assigned issue areas. The successful candidate must live in the DC metropolitan area but is not required to work from ZERO TO THREE's Washington, DC office. Note: this position requires willingness and eligibility to register as a federal lobbyist under the Lobbying Disclosure Act (LDA) upon hire. Capitol Hill experience preferred. 2-4 years of relevant experience required.

Key responsibilities include: serving as the lead Government Relations subject matter expert on federal child care, family tax, and other policy issue areas; monitoring and analyzing federal policy and legislative developments and assessing their potential impact on infants, toddlers, and families; working closely with the Sr. Government Relations and Advocacy Director and Legislative Director to develop and implement strategies to advance ZERO TO THREE's federal policy agenda; developing and maintaining relationships with congressional staff, stakeholders, and coalition partners; drafting, contributing to, and reviewing written materials including one-pagers, policy briefs, legislative summaries, public comments, and advocacy newsletters for policymakers, advocates, and other audiences; organizing and representing ZERO TO THREE in coalition meetings, congressional briefings, and other external engagements; leading the operational functions of the Government Relations Team including coordinating team logistics and tracking projects and congressional engagement; and assisting with appropriations requests, tracking legislation, and supporting sign-on letters and bill endorsements.

Qualifications: a bachelor's degree; minimum 2-4 years of relevant experience in public policy or analysis, government relations, advocacy, or a related field (Capitol Hill experience preferred); working knowledge of federal child care policy or strong interest in developing such expertise; knowledge of the federal legislative and regulatory processes; strong research, writing, and policy analysis skills; ability to apply an equity-informed lens to policy research, analysis, and advocacy; excellent written and verbal communication skills; and willingness and eligibility to register as a federal lobbyist upon hire. Must live in the DC metropolitan area.

Compensation and logistics: salary mid $60,000s-mid $70,000s depending on experience, geo-location, and budget. Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, HRA, retirement contributions, and generous leave. Must live in the DC metro area (hybrid; not required to work from the DC office). Occasional travel including overnight stays.
